METHODOLOGY AT THE END OF THE JOURNEY

DIIIP explains how strategic evidence becomes executable organisational value

In the Objectives & Initiatives Treatment, value emerges when validated strategic evidence is translated into accountable work, prioritised initiatives, funded operating envelopes and measurable organisational objectives.

D
Data

Imported SWOT factors, relevance and normalised scores, weights, evidence status, sources, price assumptions and unit-economics inputs.

I
Information

CAME responses, required work, functional ownership, linked initiatives and budget lines organise the raw evidence into a traceable decision structure.

I
Intelligence

Direction lineage, Impact, Complexity, Evidence and treatment rules help distinguish strategic attention from the resources required to execute the work.

I
Insights

The model reveals which initiatives deserve attention, where evidence or feasibility is weak, how functional budgets affect unit economics and which results are ready to become objectives.

P
Personalization Actions

Each functional area receives the objectives, budget evidence and decision context relevant to its role, while Main and Cross contributions remain visible across the organisation.
